speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment for the North-South Corridor construction project along Ang Mo Kio Avenue 6 (a) how many errant contractors were fined in 2023 for noise related infractions; (b) what are the penalties for recalcitrant offenders; and (c) what measures is the Ministry taking to minimise noise related issues from the project.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for
text: However, these contractors must still implement all practicable noise mitigation measures to minimise noise.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for
text: LTA also conducts localised stakeholder engagement and works with grassroots leaders, to inform and update the public on project-specific information.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Besides fines, are there other measures, such as project suspension or blacklisting, taken against repeat offenders causing noise infractions?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: I ask this Parliamentary Question, because many of my residents in Yio Chu Kang are affected by the noise pollution from the NSC construction.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Has the Ministry conducted any studies to assess the potential health impact of noise pollution on residents, particularly vulnerable populations, like elderly or children?

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: It is special, not just because of the scale, but because of its proximity to many residential areas, as well as the very challenging soil conditions that the contractors must work within.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: Therefore, the authorities have been taking many measures on the contractors, NEA has been monitoring very closely the disturbances and the inconveniences impacting the residents around the area.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: We will take all necessary measures and impose on the contractors to put in necessary measures to mitigate the noise.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: But really, this is a difficult balance because we need to allow the contractors to be able to have expedited progress in its works; otherwise, the project will be prolonged and extended, and that will even cause residents an extended period of inconveniences.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: So, I do thank the residents of the area, and all areas affected by the works, for their understanding and patience as we work towards its completion.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: But the level of work will be in different phases and not all works will be as noisy as it is.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: And we also appreciate the Member, Mr Yip Hon Weng, for always speaking up for his residents.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: He has had held many meetings with authorities, like LTA, the Building and Construction Authority (BCA) and NEA, to look at ways to minimise the inconveniences.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: So, we thank him and thank his residents for their understanding.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: When the works are completed, residents can look forward that the street level of Avenue 6 can be repurposed, to give priority to different purposes, like walking, cycling, public transport and community spaces.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: We look forward to working with residents to look at how we can repurpose the new space that has been created from the NSC.
